data.name: system.tag.readBlocking
data.description: Reads the value of the tags at the given tag paths. This function will block until the read operation is complete or times out.

params.name: tagPaths
params.description: A list of tag paths to read from.

params.name: timeout
params.description: How long to wait (in milliseconds) before the read operation times out.

data.returns: A list of qualified values corresponding to the tag paths.
